name: Codex Computer Use
description: Let one Codex bot inspect and control local macOS applications with approval for every action.

connection.blocker: A live Akeru Codex tool call still needs verification with a signed-in disposable environment.

setup: Install the official plugin with codex plugin add computer-use@openai-bundled --json.
Use a Codex bot on macOS. Screen Recording and Accessibility are requested only when control starts.

permissions.description: Capture the screen and inspect local applications in memory.
Click, scroll, type, use keyboard shortcuts, and open local applications.
